detail.longDescription: 🦖 SVGLineElement: y1 property ✅ Widely available (from Jul 2015) https:// developer.mozilla.org/en-US/do cs/Web/API/SVGLineElement/y1 The y1 read-only property of the SVGLineElement interface describes the start of the SVG line along the y-axis as an SVGAnimatedLength. It reflects the <line> element's y1 geometric attribute. # webdev
